# Current package build

The active package is `eivGP` 0.3.0. Its canonical implementation is maintained
in `codes/`; `litr/create-eivGP.Rmd` is the sole active package build.

```sh
Rscript --vanilla litr/render-package.R
R CMD build eivGP
R CMD check --no-manual eivGP_0.3.0.tar.gz
```

The earlier root-level book chapters and `_bookdown.yml` are historical source
for the 0.1.x package. They are not the current build and must not be used to
regenerate `eivGP/`. See `README.md` for the current package interface and
`DEVELOPMENT.md` for the separate repository experiment workflow.
